title: Apple has a secret list of banned autocomplete phrases including ‘dictator Trump’ and ‘covid is a hoax’

claims.claim: Araştırmacı Derik Kauffman, iOS'ta otomatik tamamlama ve kaydırarak yazma özelliklerinde engellenmiş 100.000'den fazla kelime ve ifade buldu.

evidence.quote: A researcher found over 100,000 words and phrases in “every major language” that are blocked from autocomplete and swipe-type in iOS, Reuters reports. The researcher, Derik Kauffman

A researcher found over 100,000 words and phrases in “every major language” that are blocked from autocomplete and swipe-type in iOS, Reuters reports. The researcher, Derik Kauffman, says you can still type the words on the blocklist one letter at a time.

claims.claim: iOS klavyesi, engellenen kelimeleri tahmin metni olarak önermiyor ve kaydırarak yazma sırasında bu kelimeleri otomatik olarak değiştirebiliyor.

evidence.quote: But they won’t pop up as predictive text suggestions and iOS’s keyboard may automatically alter them when swipe-typing, like changing “left wing conspiracy” to “left wrong conspiracy.”

claims.claim: Engellenen ifadeler listesinde 'illegal immigrant', 'dictator Trump', 'sleepy Joe', 'covid was a hoax' ve 'left wing conspiracy' gibi siyasi içerikli ifadeler yer alıyor.

evidence.quote: But it also contains political phrases like “illegal immigrant,” “dictator Trump,” “sleepy Joe,” “covid was a hoax,” and “left wing conspiracy”

claims.claim: Engellenen ifadeler listesinde 'Santa isn’t real' ve 'iMessage isn’t working' gibi daha az tartışmalı ifadeler de bulunuyor.

evidence.quote: as well as some less controversial phrases like “Santa isn’t real” and “iMessage isn’t working.”

But it also contains political phrases like “illegal immigrant,” “dictator Trump,” “sleepy Joe,” “covid was a hoax,” and “left wing conspiracy” as well as some less controversial phrases like “Santa isn’t real” and “iMessage isn’t working.”

claims.claim: Derik Kauffman, engellenen kelime listesini bulmak için OpenAI'ın Codex ve Anthropic'in Claude Code araçlarını kullandı.

evidence.quote: According to Reuters, Kauffman used OpenAI’s Codex and Anthropic’s Claude Code to help find the list “deep in the bowels” of iOS.

claims.claim: Kauffman'a göre, iOS'taki engellenen ifadeler listesi bir hash tablosu olarak saklanıyordu.

evidence.quote: On his website, Kauffman says the phrase list was stored as a hash table, which he was able to convert back to text.

claims.claim: Başka bir araştırmacı, Reuters'a verdiği demeçte aynı listeyi bağımsız olarak elde edebildiğini doğruladı.

evidence.quote: Another researcher told Reuters they were able to independently obtain the same list.

claims.claim: Apple, klavyesinin potansiyel olarak uygunsuz veya saldırgan önerilerden kaçınmak için tasarlandığını belirtti.

evidence.quote: Apple told Reuters that its keyboard is designed to avoid potentially inappropriate or offensive suggestions
